title: 第2章 相亲相爱的同门
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

转眼六日过去。

楚墨张开双眼，手中的法钱变得暗淡无光，不复原先神异。

“法钱灵机损失殆尽，修炼速度要慢下来了。”

楚墨微微皱起眉头，这几天除去外出吃饭外，自己剩下的精力全都投入到了修炼之中，在法钱的助力下一共获得60点经验。

他试过不用法钱修炼，然而很难撼动外界的自然灵炁，导致修炼速度严重下降，很长时间才会加一点经验。

‘应该可以在七八天内凝练出第一缕炁，离三十日之期还很远。看来我的天赋不算太差。’

楚墨松了口气，这下总算是不用上幡了。

他可不敢将黑袍人那日说的话当做玩笑，这鬼地方到处都是阴灵，就连厨房那几个厨子都是阴灵，谁知道有多少人成了幡上灵。

‘随意丢本书让弟子自学，学不会就进万魂幡，这要是正经宗门我吃！’

要不是有面板，单单研究功法就要浪费大量时间，到时候幡中肯定有他一席之地。

“笃笃”

一阵敲门声打断了楚墨的思绪，他连忙起身，推开门却愣了一下，四道人影正站在自己门前。

“诸位这是？”

“楚兄。”王泉见到楚墨后脸上露出一丝笑意，此时的他没了在江云涯面前的唯唯诺诺，开口道：“我有些事情要与你商量。”

王泉在凡俗的家中似乎小有势力，短短几日便与其余邻居熟络，有成为领头的架势。

只是平日里楚墨与他并无交集，不知对方为何突然来找自己，于是便开口道：“王兄，请说便是。”

“我等初入仙门，资质愚钝，修炼这《周天采气法》实在是艰难万分。”王泉叹了口气，继续道：

“我与许兄商议过，唯有将法钱集中起来，先供一人突破，方有一线生机。待其成功，再反助我等，总好过大家一起上那黑幡。”

“哦？”楚墨立正身子，好奇的问道：“不知这‘一人’指的是？”

“自然是我。”王泉挺直腰板，“我家中略有底蕴，对这仙家典籍的理解也远胜你等，已经能够采气，只要有法钱修炼定能突破。

在下不会白拿，每日抽出一个时辰为各位讲解功法如何？”说着，他便看向其他人：

“当然诸位要是不信任王某，也可以举手选举一人，少数服从多数。”

“我相信王兄。”一位蓝衫少年率先开口道。

楚墨知道对方就是王泉口中的许兄，名叫许都。这几日一直围绕着王泉转悠，一副誓要做对方跟班的模样。

他深深看了一眼对方，淡淡开口道：“在下想试试自己能力，就不参与几位的计划了。”说完，不等几人反应直接回了房间。

“呯——”

王泉望着紧闭的房门，脸色变得漆黑，又瞬间平复，没有引起其他人的注意。

他转头看向身后穿着粗布衣服的黑脸汉子，脸上挤出一丝笑意：“李二黑，你觉得我的提议怎么样？《周天采气法》很难读懂吧？”

“抱歉，王相公。”李二黑低下脑袋，不好意思的开口道：“俺...俺也想自己试试。”

“你！”

王泉一把拦住欲要发作的许都，笑容不减分毫，说道：“没事，不用道歉。既然都不同意那就算了。”

李二黑小心翼翼的抬头，确定王泉没有生气后才如蒙大赦，连忙返回自己的房间。

王泉给他讲过功法，要不是法钱事关修炼，再加上楚墨做表率，他还真不好意思拒绝对方的提议。

紫衣女子见状，开口道：“王公子，我也......”

话未说完便被王泉挥手打断，“我知道了，邵姑娘也回去修炼吧，正事要紧。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Six days passed in the blink of an eye.

Chu Mo opened his eyes, and the magic money in his hand became dim, no longer magical.

"The magic money and spiritual power are all lost, and the speed of cultivation will slow down."

Chu Mo frowned slightly. Apart from going out to eat these days, all his remaining energy was devoted to practice. With the help of magic money, he gained a total of 60 experience points.

He tried practicing without magic money, but it was difficult to shake the natural energy of the outside world, which caused a serious slowdown in his cultivation speed, and it took a long time for him to gain some experience.

‘It should be possible to condense the first ray of Qi within seven or eight days, which is still far from the thirty-day period.It seems that my talent is not too bad.’

Chu Mo breathed a sigh of relief, and now he no longer had to carry the flag.

He didn't dare to take what the man in black robe said that day as a joke. This ghost place is full of Yin spirits, even the cooks in the kitchen are Yin spirits. Who knows how many people have become banner spirits.

'Throw a book at random and let the disciples learn on their own. If they can't learn it, they will join the Ten Thousand Souls Banner. If this is a serious sect, I will eat it!’

If it weren't for the panel, a lot of time would be wasted just studying the techniques. He would definitely have a place in the banners by then.

"Tuk Tuk"

A knock on the door interrupted Chu Mo's thoughts. He quickly stood up and opened the door, but was stunned for a moment. Four figures were standing in front of his door.

"What is this, everyone?"

"Brother Chu." A smile appeared on Wang Quan's face after seeing Chu Mo. At this time, he lost his submissiveness in front of Jiang Yunya and said, "I have something to discuss with you."

Wang Quan seems to have a small influence in the ordinary family. In just a few days, he has become familiar with other neighbors and has become the leader.

However, Chu Mo had no contact with him on weekdays. He didn't know why the other party came to him suddenly, so he said, "Brother Wang, please tell me."

"We have just entered the Immortal Sect and have dull qualifications. It is really difficult to practice the "Zhoutian Qi Collection Method"." Wang Quan sighed and continued:

"Brother Xu and I have discussed that the only way to have a chance of survival is to pool the magic money and give it to one person to break through first. When he succeeds, he can then help me and others. It is better than everyone going up to the black flag together."

"Oh?" Chu Mo stood up straight and asked curiously, "I wonder who this 'person' refers to?"

"Of course it's me." Wang Quan straightened his back, "My family has some background, and my understanding of the immortal family's classics is far better than yours. I can already collect qi. As long as I have the magic money to practice, I will definitely be able to break through.

I won’t take it for free. How about taking an hour every day to explain the exercises to you?"As he said that, he looked at the others:

"Of course, if you don't trust Wang, you can also raise your hands to elect someone, and the minority will obey the majority."

"I believe Brother Wang." A young man in a blue shirt spoke first.

Chu Mo knew that the other party was the brother Xu mentioned by Wang Quan, named Xu Du.In the past few days, he has been wandering around Wang Quan, as if he vowed to be his follower.

He took a deep look at the other party and said calmly: "I want to test my ability, so I won't participate in your plan." After saying that, he went back to the room without waiting for their reaction.

"Boom——"

Wang Quan looked at the closed door, his face turned dark, and then calmed down instantly, without attracting the attention of others.

He turned to look at the dark-faced man in coarse clothes behind him, with a smile on his face: "Li Erhei, what do you think of my proposal? "Zhou Tian Qi Collection Method" is difficult to understand, isn't it?"

"Sorry, Mr. Wang." Li Erhei lowered his head and said sheepishly: "I...I also want to try it myself."

"You!"

Wang Quan stopped Xu Du, who was about to have a fit, and said with an undiminished smile: "It's okay, no need to apologize. Since you don't agree, forget it."

Li Erhei raised his head cautiously, and after making sure that Wang Quan was not angry, he quickly returned to his room as if he was being pardoned.

Wang Quan had taught him the exercises. If the money hadn't been related to cultivation, and Chu Mo had set an example, he would have been embarrassed to refuse the other party's proposal.

Seeing this, the woman in purple said, "Young Master Wang, I too..."

Before he finished speaking, he was interrupted by Wang Quan with a wave of his hand, "I understand. Miss Shao, please go back to practice. Business is more important."
